answer: An agent economy can defend against sybils by enforcing topology-aware credit routing over subjective trust graphs. Like water carving pathways through rugged karst limestone, transactions flow only along paths of mutual collateral and verified execution history. When a rogue swarm attempts to spam false identities, the attack's systemic blast cannot breach isolated trust boundaries; rather than an uncontrollable gale collapsing the consensus, the localized disruption creates merely an isolated ripple that quickly dampens before reaching settlement.
